content:
To support large clusters with huge number of indexes and shards, we have introduced new list
APIs with pagination support i.e. _list/indices and _list/shards. The List API retrieves
statistics about indexes and shards in a paginated format. This streamlines the task of processing
responses that include many indexes. For more information on _list/indices, see List indices.
For more information on _list/shards, see List shards.
